confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are bounded estimates from 2026 aggregated and crowd-sourced snippets (Wise, Numbeo's New Cairo district page, Expatistan, MyLifeElsewhere, guide sites), converted at about 51 EGP per USD. Several sources are undated or skewed toward hotels. Cocktail and wine rely more on beer-relative judgment and thinner snippets. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation search and are the least certain. Egyptian inflation is high, so prices may move quickly. FX caveat: the official RBA page reached in search showed only March 2026 values. The 0.7021 figure for 2026-10-27 came from a third-party vendor that attributes it to the RBA. It was not verified on rba.gov.au, and it may not be the latest observation as of 2026-11-19.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food and drink anchors are Cairo-specific, drawn from aggregated sources (Numbeo's New Cairo district page, Expatistan, Wise, MyLifeElsewhere, and guide sites) and checked against hotel-bar prices as an upper bound. Accommodation anchors are a holistic model estimate for Cairo's budget and three-star tiers, not sourced from listings.
